passives.name: JudarEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
On switching to Lightning Magic:
- Summon an Arc of Lightning on the path inside of this unit's range
- Enemies that are touching Arc of Lightning will take {1}% of this unit's current damage every {2} second

passives.name: JudarEquipmentPassive2
passives.description:
On switching to Ice Magic:
- This unit gains $Freeze on attack
On $RegularAttack:
- Gain {1} stack of $JudarMeter per enemy hit (Capacity: {2})
At {2} $JudarMeter stacks:
- This unit's next attack against enemies inflicted with $Freeze will shatter, unfreezing them and dealing {3}% additional damage in a small AoE ({4} range)
